caption:
The service identification workflow. Banner grabbing and Nmap -sV run against the same open port — both aiming at the same output: the version number.

The version number is the pivotal point. Without it, the CVE database cannot be searched systematically. With it, the path from 'open port' to 'confirmed vulnerability' is direct and evidence-based.

Note: when both methods agree on the same version, confidence is high. When they disagree, the discrepancy is itself a finding.
